editorial:
You get a fun return to the Dragon Ball world after Majin Buu, with Beerus waking up hungry for a challenge and the Z-fighters scrambling to protect Earth. The birthday party setup keeps things light, while Goku’s drive to reach Super Saiyan God gives the story a clear goal. It feels like a big reunion with familiar faces, jokes, and rising tension as Beerus tests everyone’s strength, patience, and courage.

The high-energy action is colorful and fast, and the new god-level powers look great on screen. Some scenes move slowly, and the ritual setup takes time, but the big payoff is worth it. Fans of classic Dragon Ball will love the callbacks, while newcomers may need a quick recap before diving in. Watch it with friends in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound quality.
endingExplained: Goku becomes Super Saiyan God and fights Beerus, but he still cannot win. Beerus decides to destroy Earth, yet he stops after tasting Earth food and enjoying the battle. Whis reveals Beerus only used part of his power, so Goku has room to grow. Beerus leaves peacefully, and the Z-fighters celebrate with relief, knowing a stronger threat could return someday soon.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves anime action and Dragon Ball nostalgia.
